Both are stated by the sources cited and neither was chosen over the other by anybody here — a reviewer decides.

title: Siege of Bergen op Zoom (1622)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Bergen op Zoom (1622)", at revision 1370739522, opens: "The siege of Bergen op Zoom (1622) was a siege during the Eighty Years' War that took place from 18 July to 2 October 1622. The Spanish general Ambrosio Spinola laid siege to the Dutch city of Bergen op Zoom." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1838038, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between Dutch and Spanish in 1622". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
